title: PortfolioVault.setLoans: missing access control
description: In PortfolioVault.setLoans (src/PortfolioVault.sol) the access control modifier onlyRole(GUARDIAN_ROLE) was removed, so any address can call this function.

title: PortfolioVault.approveRedemption: missing check
description: In PortfolioVault.approveRedemption (src/PortfolioVault.sol) the check "require(assets > 0, ZeroAmount());" was removed, so the condition is no longer enforced.

title: PortfolioVault.acceptSaleOffer: off-by-one in a boundary check
description: In PortfolioVault.acceptSaleOffer (src/PortfolioVault.sol) the comparison in "require(uint256(offer.price) <= idleLiquidity(), InsufficientLiquidity());" was shifted by one (>= became > or <= became <), an off-by-one in a boundary check.

title: PortfolioVault.setMaxNavComputationTime: missing access control
description: In PortfolioVault.setMaxNavComputationTime (src/PortfolioVault.sol) the access control modifier onlyAdminOrGuardian was removed, so any address can call this function.
